verdict.line: You win by forcing extended trades before level 6 and denying Garen's passive regen with constant pressure; you lose if you sit back and let him hit level 6 with Ignite and Demacian Justice ready.

brief.thesis: Garen has no ranged poke and has to land his E (Judgment) spin or his Q (Decisive Strike) silenced auto at point-blank range to do anything, which is exactly the range your W (Defiant Dance) is built to absorb. Irelia holds both the lane and solo-kill advantage here, but the head-to-head win rate sits at 48.3% over 689 games because Garen's R (Demacian Justice) execute and Perseverance sustain punish players who let him free-farm to level 6 untouched.

theirWindow.when: level 6+, his R and Ignite up
theirWindow.what: Demacian Justice executes low-current-health targets and pairs with Ignite for a kill well before your health bar looks low. Do not commit W charge or dive under roughly 40% HP once he has both up.

yourWindow.when: after he whiffs or burns Q/E
yourWindow.what: With Decisive Strike and Judgment down he has no way to silence your dash or punish your engage. Bladesurge onto him, land E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then Q again since Bladesurge refreshes its cooldown on Marked targets.

powerCurve.note: E stun lands before he has answers
W absorbs his E/Q burst in trades

start.why: Highest-sample, highest-pick start (47.1% win, 86.7% pick) — the extra sustain and damage matter because Garen wins pure attrition if you let him keep landing E.

boots.why: 82.9% pick and the higher-winning boot option; flat physical reduction directly undercuts his E spin and Q-empowered auto, the only two ways he damages you.

core.why: Current-health damage and the attack speed slow keep pressure on him through his Perseverance regen window instead of letting it tick back up.
Highest win-rate core path (57.1% over 126 games) — rewards the split-push and duel pattern this matchup already favors you in.
Damage reduction over time neutralizes his burst windows around R + Ignite while you keep dealing sustained damage back.

situational.when: you're ahead and want to end fights faster instead of grinding through his regen
he builds early armor or the game stalls into a longer duel-heavy split-push phase
he's snowballing and threatening to one-shot you with R + Ignite at your next power spike
their team stacks hard CC beyond just Garen's Q silence

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramps through the exact extended, melee-range trades this lane produces, and the healing helps you outlast Garen's Perseverance regen instead of losing the war of attrition.

summoners.why: 82.7% pick rate for a reason — Ignite denies his Perseverance passive during your all-in window and directly answers his own Ignite in the level-6 R race OP.GG flags as the key danger point.

playing.title: All-in before level 6
playing.detail: Garen has no silence or gap-closer answer to your E stun until his kit is fully online. Force fights at levels 2-5 while he has no way to punish your engage.

playing.title: Track his Q before committing E
playing.detail: Decisive Strike (8s cooldown) silences on his next auto — if it's up, he can cancel your follow-up. Bait it with a W charge or wait it out before diving in with your stun.

playing.title: Charge W into his E
playing.detail: Defiant Dance takes reduced physical damage while charging and deals more the longer you hold it — time the release to land right as he finishes his Judgment spin.

playing.title: Chain E into Q for resets
playing.detail: Flawless Duet Marks him; Bladesurge's cooldown refreshes on Marked or killed targets, so E into Q lets you reset instantly and keep dashing rather than auto-ing him down.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 execute
playing.detail: Demacian Justice plus Ignite can kill from a health total that looks safe. Once he's level 6 with both up, don't extend trades below roughly 40% HP.

playing.title: Deny his passive between trades
playing.detail: Perseverance only regens if he hasn't taken damage recently — poke with Q on minions to reposition and re-engage rather than letting him walk away and heal back to full.

playing.title: Play for the duel, not the poke war
playing.detail: He has zero ranged pressure. There's no reason to trade at range; every fight you force in melee range is one where your kit has more tools than his.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are measured from real games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade timings are my own read of the kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Absorb Garen’s damage with a well-timed [W]. Be careful of Garen’s (R) + Ignite when he reaches level 6, and try to engage to your advantage using [P] stacks.
